root.label: Brazil revokes visa of senior Trump envoy

events.label: Brazil revokes visa of senior Trump envoy

slots.name: visa status
slots.sentence: In March, Brazil revoked the visa of a senior Trump envoy after learning that he planned to visit Jair Bolsonaro, the former president convicted of plotting a coup after losing the last election, and meet his son, Flávio Bolsonaro, who is running for president this fall.
